packages.title: Darjeeling Monsoon Escape
packages.short: Misty 3N/4D Darjeeling & Mirik monsoon escape with tea gardens, Tiger Hill, and cloud-kissed Himalayan views.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrival at NJP / Bagdogra, scenic uphill drive through pine & tea gardens to Darjeeling, hotel check-in, evening leisure walk at Mall Road & Chowrasta. Day 2: Early morning Tiger Hill sunrise view, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, followed by Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (HMI), P.N. Zoo and Happy Valley Tea Estate. Day 3: Full-day scenic excursion to Mirik Lake (Sumendu Lake), pine forest walk, Pashupati viewpoint, and return to Darjeeling. Day 4: Morning breakfast, check-out, scenic drive via Kurseong tea hills to NJP railway station / Bagdogra airport for departure.
packages.inclusions: Hotel accommodation (3 Nights), daily breakfast, dedicated private vehicle for transfers & sightseeing, driver allowances, toll and parking.
packages.exclusions: Train/air fare, entry tickets to monuments & zoo, personal expenses, meals not specified, joy ride on Toy Train.
packages.route: NJP / Bagdogra → Darjeeling → Tiger Hill & Local Sightseeing → Mirik Lake → Kurseong → NJP / Bagdogra

packages.title: Darjeeling Hill Escape

Day 2: Early morning drive to Tiger Hill for majestic Kanchenjunga sunrise, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery; post breakfast visit HMI, P.N. Zoo and local tea estate. packages.inclusions: Hotel accommodation (2 Nights), daily breakfast, private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing, driver allowances, toll and parking.

packages.title: Sittong & Offbeat Darjeeling
packages.short: Peaceful 2N/3D orange orchard and Himalayan village getaway covering Sittong, Ahaldhara viewpoint, Namthing Pokhri and Takdah pine heritage.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Pickup from NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport, scenic drive along Teesta valley to Sittong (the Orange Village). Check-in at traditional eco-homestay, village walk through orange orchards, and sunset at Ahaldhara Viewpoint. Day 2: Morning nature walk to Namthing Pokhri (Salamander habitat). Post breakfast, explore Takdah pine heritage trails, British colonial bungalows, and Tinchuley valley viewpoints. Day 3: Morning breakfast with valley mist, check-out, and scenic return transfer to NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport for departure.
packages.inclusions: Homestay/resort accommodation (2 Nights), daily breakfast & dinner, dedicated private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing, driver allowances, toll and parking.
packages.exclusions: Train/flight tickets, personal expenses, entry fees if applicable, meals not mentioned.
packages.route: NJP / Bagdogra → Sittong → Ahaldhara Viewpoint → Namthing Pokhri → Takdah & Tinchuley → NJP / Bagdogra

packages.title: Offbeat North Bengal
packages.short: Serene 2N/3D journey through offbeat North Bengal covering Samsing tea valleys, Suntalekhola suspension bridge, Jhalong river valley, and Bindu dam on the Bhutan border.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Pickup from NJP Railway Station / New Mal Junction / Bagdogra Airport. Drive through lush Dooars tea estates to Samsing / Suntalekhola eco-resort or homestay. Check-in, relax, and take an afternoon walk to the hanging footbridge across Suntalekhola river. Evening at leisure amidst forest sounds. Day 2: Morning excursion to Jhalong on the banks of Jaldhaka River. Proceed to Bindu, the last village on the Indo-Bhutan border with views of the Jaldhaka Hydel Project and cardamom hills. Return via Rocky Island on the Murti River for photo stops and evening sunset. Day 3: Morning breakfast surrounded by tea garden mist, check-out, and scenic return transfer to NJP Railway Station / New Mal Junction for onward journey.
packages.inclusions: Eco-resort/homestay accommodation (2 Nights), daily breakfast & dinner, dedicated private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing, driver allowances, toll and parking.
packages.exclusions: Train/flight tickets, forest entry permits or safari charges if applicable, personal expenses, meals not specified.
packages.route: NJP / New Mal → Samsing → Suntalekhola → Jhalong → Bindu (Bhutan Border) → Rocky Island → NJP / New Mal

faqs.q: How can I book a package?
faqs.a: Submit the enquiry form or contact TOURIM by phone/WhatsApp. The team will share quotation and booking steps.

faqs.q: Does the package include train or flight?
faqs.a: It depends on the selected package. Each package clearly lists inclusions and exclusions.

faqs.q: Can I get group tour and honeymoon packages?
faqs.a: Yes. TOURIM supports group tours, family trips, honeymoon plans, domestic and international packages.
